name: E-3G Sentry
note: USAF E-3 Sentry AWACS (E-3G is the Block 40/45-upgraded standard), based on the Boeing 707. Unarmed. AN/APY-2 pulse-Doppler surveillance radar in a rotodome. Flight crew 4 plus 13-19 mission crew.

source.title: Boeing E-3 Sentry | Wikipedia
source.note: AN/APY-2 pulse-Doppler radar: 'range of more than 250 mi (400 km) for low-flying targets' and 'approximately 400 mi (650 km) for aircraft flying at medium altitude'. Value is the low-altitude figure.

source.title: No published combat radius (AWACS)
source.note: No published radius; estimated on-station orbit radius. Unrefuelled endurance ~8 h; unlimited with aerial refuelling.

source.title: Boeing E-3 Sentry | Wikipedia
source.note: 'unrefueled range of more than 5,000 nmi (9,300 km)'; the specifications table gives 4,000 nmi (7,400 km) - taken the larger, stated figure.

source.title: Boeing E-3 Sentry | Wikipedia
source.note: Flight crew of 4 plus mission crew of 13-19; ~21 taken as a representative total.

name: A-50U Mainstay
note: Beriev A-50U, the modernised Mainstay AEW&C based on the Il-76. Unarmed. Liana (Shmel-M) surveillance radar in a rotodome; 15-man mission crew; can control up to 10 fighters. On-station radius ~1,000 km for 4 hours.

source.title: Beriev A-50 | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Detection range is 650 kilometres for air targets and 300 kilometres for ground targets.' Value is the air-target figure.

source.title: Beriev A-50 | Wikipedia
source.note: 'The A-50 can fly for four hours with a range of 1,000 kilometres from its base' - an on-station orbit radius, not a strike radius.

source.title: Beriev A-50 | Wikipedia
source.note: Specifications: maximum speed '850 km/h (530 mph, 460 kn)'; cruise is quoted as 750-800 km/h. The maximum is recorded, consistent with how the other aircraft in this library record speed.

name: KJ-500
note: Shaanxi KJ-500 AEW&C (current standard is the aerial-refuelling KJ-500A), based on the Y-9 airframe. Unarmed. Fixed dorsal radome with three AESA arrays for 360-degree coverage.

source.title: Shaanxi KJ-500 | Wikipedia
source.note: Published Chinese parameters: 'Range against fighter sized targets (km): 470'.

source.title: No published combat radius (AWACS)
source.note: No published radius; estimated on-station orbit radius. Max range 5,700 km and endurance 12 h (KJ-500A adds aerial refuelling).

name: E-2D Advanced Hawkeye
note: Northrop Grumman E-2D Advanced Hawkeye, carrier-borne AEW&C. Unarmed. AN/APY-9 UHF-band radar (suspected to have some capability against fighter-sized stealth targets). Crew of 5.

source.title: Northrop Grumman E-2 Hawkeye | Wikipedia
source.note: AN/APY-9: 'detecting 20,000 targets to a range greater than 400 mi (640 km)' while tracking over 2,000 and guiding 40-100 intercepts.

source.title: No published combat radius (AWACS)
source.note: No published radius; estimated on-station orbit ~200 nmi from the carrier. Endurance 6 h (8 h land-based).

source.title: Northrop Grumman E-2 Hawkeye | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Crew: 5': pilot, copilot, and three mission-system operators.
